headline: 🔥 PAN-OS Zero-Day Exploitation Details, 🇮🇷 MuddyWater False Flag, 🤖 Claude AI OT Attack, 🍎 ClickFix macOS Infostealers, 📦 NuGet Supply Chain, 🎓 Education Breach
summary: PAN-OS CVE-2026-0300 exploitation details emerge with AD lateral movement via firewall credentials — patches still weeks away. MuddyWater uses Chaos ransomware as false flag for espionage through Microsoft Teams phishing. Claude AI used to build 17K-line attack framework targeting Mexican water utility OT systems. Multiple supply-chain attacks on NuGet (65K downloads), PyPI (OceanLotus), and npm ecosystems.
